what_happened: Scene L7: green sponge_4 on a light marble counter, large dark cutting_board_4 to its left. Stage 0 normal: grasp 111, lifted 7.7 cm, moved 21 cm onto the board, stage 0 from 112. Stage 1: pressed down at ~150 (counter 1). From 152 to 238 finger_joint1 sat at its open limit (q1 0.040, q2 -0.016..-0.018; sum width unchanged 0.057), so OU.check_obj_grasped was False. In that window the sponge was held flat (tilt <= 3 deg until ~196, 7-13 deg after) and slid along the board ~36 cm (y +0.02 -> -0.35). The wrist view shows wood under the sponge the whole time, and stage 0 (sponge not touching the counter) held throughout. None of it counted. 244-276 grasp True again but the return stroke (19 cm) was slightly lifted and gave no contact; 284-308 it moved off the board's right edge and released at 312 on the counter beside the board (eef > 15 cm at 322). Final 1 contact, sweep 0. 330-800: arm raised, looking around, no further attempt.
causal_chain: first press 150 (counted) -> fingers shifted sideways in the hand so the env's grasp test (finger 1 only) failed 152-238 -> the main ~36 cm stroke on the board was not counted -> return stroke lifted -> sponge released at 312 after a ~160-step scrub (as long as successful s0's 153 steps) with 1/5 contacts -> wandered to timeout
official_criterion_notes: Main case for the finger-1 artifact. The env's grasp test reduces to finger_joint1 < 0.035, because finger_joint2's qpos is negative so its '< 0.035' test always passes. The sponge was held and visibly scrubbed along the board, but the counter was blind for 152-238. The 156-196 part alone (flat sponge, 10 cm of travel, height at or below the counted contact at 150) would likely have given about 5 points over about 10 cm.
